headline: Reconciled diverged main branches, corrected ProteinEBM benchmarks, and merged PR #112/PR #117.
primary_goal: Resolve repository state divergence between local and origin main, audit ProteinEBM benchmarks, and merge pending PRs.

key_decisions.what: Create an isolated worktree to merge 'origin/main' into local 'main'.
key_decisions.why: The local 'main' was ~40 commits ahead of the ProteinEBM epic while 'origin/main' had advanced 19 commits independently, causing PR #112 to show as 'CONFLICTING'.
The autofix would have stripped required quotes from jaxtyping annotations, leading to a crash.

key_decisions.what: Push a fast-forward update (PR #117) directly to main.
key_decisions.why: To reconcile the diverged history after verifying the merge was textually clean and passed linting.

key_decisions.what: Rebase PR #112 onto the new main and squash-merge with admin override.
key_decisions.why: To finalize the integration of the ProteinEBM epic after verifying green CI status and resolving a uv.lock conflict.
To clean up redundant benchmark data, prune 9 stale worktrees, and preserve active refactor worktrees.

failed_attempts.why_failed: Introduced 33 new diagnostics, but these were determined to be false positives from dummy test objects.
The benchmarks were flawed because PyTorch was running on CPU while JAX ran on GPU; corrected GPU-vs-GPU benchmarks show 2–7x.

state_working: Static analysis (ty) and linting (ruff) - after fixing autofix

blockers.description: Blackwell-specific compiler bug (CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS) blocking JAX's superior heterogeneous batching strategy.
blockers.suggested_resolution: Monitor for compiler updates or investigate workarounds for the Blackwell architecture.

blockers.description: torch.compile fails for 'decoy' due to process-level introspection issues.
blockers.suggested_resolution: Investigate process-level introspection limitations in the 'decoy' workflow.

next_steps: Continue work on refactors identified in preserved worktrees.
Monitor for resolution of the Blackwell compiler bug.
critical_context: Benchmark Correction: 11-92x (CPU vs GPU) -> 2-7x (GPU vs GPU)
open_questions: When will the Blackwell-specific compiler bug be addressed?
gaps: Specific details on the 'decoy' process-level introspection issues are not fully documented.
